3 months is the max visa for tourists (you can ask for extension but they don’t have to give you). 

My current experience on inviting my grandma here (Brazil) for less than a month has been a nightmare but you need her passport, proofs of connection with her country like pay slips, house ownership or rent proof, birth certificate of her and your spouse and a letter of the Israeli inviting. You can go to your misrad hapnim, we went in the morning but we ended up not going to our misrad office but to Jaffa because there’s a paper saying that tourist visa is dealt in Jaffa but it’s a mess so just go to your office. Good luck 

Ah we translated the documents using Claude and they accepted
